<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Included since Arcantry 0.3.0</span><code>$stage-code-review-findings</code></p>

Perform an approval-gated code review whose findings remain in chat until the user selects which ones may advance. Use when the user asks for a local, chat-only, draft, or pre-publication review; wants findings in Polish with stable IDs, file paths, line ranges, problem descriptions, and problem types; or wants only accepted findings translated to English and later written, drafted, submitted, or published to GitHub, Azure DevOps, a browser form, a file, or another named destination.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link stage-code-review-findings
```

## Examples

### Review without publishing

**Prompt**

> Use $stage-code-review-findings to review my uncommitted changes. Keep every finding in Polish and in chat only.

**Expected outcome**

Actionable findings with stable IDs, tight line anchors, and no source edits, browser drafts, or provider mutations.

### Publish selected findings only

**Prompt**

> Accept F1 and F3 from the staged review and prepare them for the named pull request. Leave every other finding unpublished.

**Expected outcome**

Only the accepted findings advance in concise reviewer-facing English after their anchors are revalidated.
